reading.unclear: The carton's base in frame 1 is cut off by the zoom crop, so whether it rests on the desk or floats cannot be confirmed. In frame 2 the carton's lower edge is at the desk line, and whether it touches the surface cannot be confirmed at this size. The graphics are too small in both frames to read beyond the brand, flavour and 'Energy & Focus' text. The 'Hero vs villain' and 'Villain vs villain' captions may be part of the video rather than admin marks. The message that carried the coordinate note (original 1192x2325, displayed 1025x2000) had no file path, so I used the composite and the two marked frames read above.
